articles.title: Snapchat takes aim at Partiful with new event-planning features - TechCrunch
articles.description: Snapchat says the new features can be used to organize everything from birthday celebrations and sporting events to study sessions and weekend hangouts.
articles.content: Snapchat announced on Thursday that it’s launching “Snapchat Plans,” a suite of features for creating, sharing, and managing real-world events with friends. The new event-planning features allow user… [+2270 chars]
